decisions.reason: Although it remained listed through 2024, this healthcare and hospitality recruitment service is far from the firm's maritime knowledge base, so even with in-house R&D the firm has weaker absorptive capacity to learn from it and is likely to reallocate resources to more related offerings.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's established crewing capabilities and customer relationships, so management can interpret market feedback well and continue refining it.
The maritime education programme strongly fits the firm's training assets and showed early traction through a six-institution partner network, making it a natural product to retain and develop.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services are close to the core business, strategically aligned with regulation-driven demand, and already demonstrated successful execution for all relevant vessels.
The emissions compliance dashboard builds on the firm's digital ship-management software and maritime compliance know-how, so its absorptive capacity for improving and commercialising it is high.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool is related to the firm's software and regulatory service offer, and despite being newer it fits the firm's direction toward digital efficiency and environmental performance.
